subject: general
question: How is the chromosome number maintained from one generation to another in sexually reproducing organisms?

options.text: Halving of chromosomes during gamete formation
Doubling of chromosomes during zygote formation
Halving of chromosomes during zygote formation
Doubling of chromosomes during gamete formation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Halving of chromosomes during gamete formation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Halving of chromosomes during gamete formation** is crucial for maintaining the chromosome number from one generation to another in sexually reproducing organisms.
 
• This process occurs during meiosis, where the chromosome number is halved in the gametes (sperm and egg cells).
